type_definitions.definition: A sovereign state or nation.
A numerical amount or measure.
A period of time corresponding to one of the twelve divisions of a year.
One of the world's main continuous expanses of land.
The length of time that something continues or exists.
A rate, number, or amount in each hundred.
A specified period of time between two dates.
An individual human being.
A specific role or office held within a government or political organization.
The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.
A particular day of the month or year, as specified by a number and month.
A measure of the warmth or coldness of an object or substance.
A large and densely populated urban area.
An area or division, especially part of a country or the world having definable characteristics but not always fixed boundaries.
A structured group of people with a particular purpose.
A cluster or chain of islands.
The status of belonging to a particular nation.
A natural occurrence or event related to the environment.
A quantity or extent ascertained by measuring.
A measure, quantity, or frequency, typically one measured against another quantity or measure.
A category of people defined by their age range.
A department of a government led by a minister.
An administrative unit of government.
One of the seven days of the week.
A span of temperatures between a minimum and maximum value.
A measure of the extent of a surface.
A densely populated area, typically smaller than a city but larger than a village.
A piece of land almost surrounded by water but joined to the mainland on one side.
An official announcement or statement made by a government.
A specific point in time, including both date and time components.
A classification indicating the severity or urgency of a warning.
An organization that seeks to achieve and maintain political power.
A specific objective or aim that a policy seeks to achieve.
A course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government, party, business, or individual.
A specific occurrence or phenomenon related to atmospheric conditions.
The state of the atmosphere at a particular place and time.
A natural occurrence in the atmosphere.
A stock or supply of money, materials, staff, and other assets that can be drawn on by a person or organization in order to function effectively.
A sudden event, such as an accident or a natural catastrophe, that causes great damage or loss of life.
The specific injury or disease that leads to death.
An organization or economic system where goods and services are exchanged for one another or for money.
A living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs and nervous system and able to respond rapidly to stimuli.

Each of the four divisions of the year (spring, summer, autumn, and winter) marked by particular weather patterns and daylight hours, resulting from the earth's changing position with regard to the sun.
An observation of the number of deaths above the expected baseline.
A prediction of future temperature conditions.
An observation of the percentage increase in deaths.
A claim or statement regarding an increase in deaths.
An event marking the highest temperature recorded on a specific day.
An observation of a specific temperature value.
An event where an official warning about high temperatures is issued.
An event describing the formation and strengthening of a high-pressure weather system.
An event describing the effects of extreme heat on a population or area.
A claim or statement about the effects of climate change.
A claim or statement identifying a continent as warming at the highest rate.
An event characterized by a rise in the frequency or intensity of heatwaves.
An event describing increased strain or demand on a water supply system.
An event characterized by wildfires of high severity or destructive power.
An observation about the age or other demographic characteristics of deceased individuals.
A claim or statement that the number of deaths is without prior example.
A claim or statement that a reported figure is likely lower than the actual value.
An observation of the number of fatalities caused by drowning.
An event where a red alert, indicating a severe threat, is officially issued.
A claim or statement warning about the danger of forest fires.
An observation of the number of fires that have started.
An observation of the total land area consumed by fire.
An event involving the removal of people from a dangerous place.
An event where a government declares a heightened state of readiness or caution.
An event where an orange alert, indicating a significant threat, is issued.
A claim or statement indicating that risks are expected to grow.
An event where animals become sick.
An event where a formal suggestion or plan is not accepted.
A prolonged period of abnormally hot weather.

Indicates the time period or event within which another event or observation took place.
Indicates a general connection or association between two entities or nodes.
Indicates the intended or predicted recipient or location of a forecast.
Indicates a relationship of comparison between two entities or values.
Indicates the function or position that a person or entity holds.
Indicates the subject matter or topic that an entity or node is about.
Indicates the specific date or day when an event or observation took place.
Indicates the entity or group that was influenced or impacted by an event.
Indicates the agent or factor responsible for an event or outcome.
Indicates the origin or starting point of something.
Indicates the direction or destination of movement or influence.
Indicates the speed or frequency at which something occurs or changes.
Indicates the starting point in time from which an event or condition has continued.
Indicates the entity that officially released or published something.
Indicates the purpose or intended recipient of an action or item.
Indicates the location where an event or process began.
Indicates the destination or extent of something's expansion.
Indicates the entity that made an official statement or announcement.
Indicates the end point in time for which a state or condition will persist.
Indicates the degree or intensity of a particular state or condition.
Indicates the beginning point in time or origin of an event or condition.
Indicates the entity that put forward a suggestion or plan.
Indicates what an entity or concept is substituted by.
Indicates the classification or category of an entity or event.
